data.action: 停驻在崖边观景处，端坐于轮椅静赏晚霞
data.description: 【蕾缪安 · 拉特兰悬崖】黄昏夕阳如熔金般洒满拉特兰边缘的观景悬崖，蕾缪安将轮椅停驻在石栏旁，静静欣赏着天际翻滚的壮美晚霞。微风吹动她浅灰色的长发，她侧过头温和地开口——「哪怕双腿暂时无法站立，只要有你推着我，这片大地上所有的美景我都依然能够尽收眼底。」
data.promptProse: Lemuen parks her wheelchair beside the clifftop's low stone rail, hands folded over the warm lap blanket and dark tailored overcoat while she watches the sunset. Hair moves in the evening wind beneath halo and softly glowing translucent wings. The wide three-quarter rear view opens toward orange-violet clouds below the lookout. Their reflected light warms the stone rail and chair frame, while softer wing glow separates her from the darker near ground.
data.title: 蕾缪安 · 拉特兰悬崖
